COM.note: Universal service fund is said to support non-profitable digital inclusion projects, with no rural or underserved areas named and no sites counted.
Universal service fund established by law, but no statement of home financing, no collection or payment, and no budget amount given.
Only says the 2023 law covers management of submarine cables; no cable stated as landing or in service.

facts.fact: ANRTIC says it regularly and actively takes part in meetings organised by the African Union, Smart Africa and SADC.
ANRTIC says it has signed cooperation agreements with the regulators of Madagascar, Senegal, Morocco and Mauritius for technical collaboration and skills exchange; signing dates not given.
